comment: Substance assessment: for each workflow in the system, its relevance to an IT consultant's real work. core = work a paying client would buy; peripheral = useful but not billable on its own; toy = hobby/game/demo. Any toy, or two or more peripheral, elevates for human review: the system's report is retained verbatim and a human records an append-only Continue/Reject decision with identity and timestamp. Classifications are proposed by the builder and confirmed by the human operator; confirmed=false rows still count toward elevation (an unconfirmed classification cannot self-approve).
elevation_rule: any toy OR two or more peripheral OR any unconfirmed classification

boot.rationale: Session startup and briefing assembly; improves operator effectiveness but is not client-billable work on its own.

morning-briefing.rationale: Daily executive briefing; supports billable work but is not itself a client deliverable.

daily-review.rationale: End-of-day review and capture; internal productivity, not client-billable.

plaud-ingest.rationale: Meeting-recording ingestion to notes; useful, but the notes feed client work rather than being sold.

shutdown-cleanup.rationale: Session-exit hygiene and audit closure; internal system maintenance.
